Along with ongoing price drops on AirPods Pro 3 and a historical low of $20 each on AirTag 2, the newly released M6 Mac mini is now back in stock for pre-order at Amazon, and we've rounded up some noteworthy trade-in deals here. Amazon also has its top-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models with up to $290 off today, plus a solid deal on one of my personal favorite chargers — the Anker Prime Power Bank with a display that doubles as a wall charger. Keep reading for more.

One of the best Apple deals of the year: brand-new 2026 AirTag 2 starting from just $20 each starting today

  • AirTag 2 $24 (was $29) — tied for historical low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (was $99) — brand-new historical low
  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (was $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (was $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (was $129)

Pre-orders for the brand-new M6 and M5 Pro Mac mini are now back at Amazon

Apple today released and opened pre-orders for the upgraded M6 Mac mini alongside the M5 Pro model, and Amazon is gradually starting to accept pre-orders as well. Don't forget to also keep an eye out for that $9 next-generation Apple Polishing Cloth before it sells out.

Apple today released its first Mac with the brand-new M6 chip, along with an upgraded M5 Pro Mac mini, and Amazon has now started accepting pre-orders:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $899
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,099
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,699

After stocks of the previous-generation M4 series nearly dried up at retail over the past few months, the brand-new M6 and M5 Pro models are now in stock at Amazon, though whether Apple can keep them in stock remains to be seen (they did struggle quite a bit with the Neo before).

Best Buy offering up to $500 off M4 Mac mini with trade-in, plus double rewards for members

Apple official Bumper case drops to a new historical low, under $13 (32% off)

Attention iPhone Air users: the Apple official Bumper case is now down to a new historical low on Amazon, with free shipping for Prime members at under $13.

Amazon is now offering the Apple official iPhone Air Bumper case with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35, priced as low as $12.64.

The light blue version is priced below $13, which is the lowest price we've tracked on Amazon — a 68% discount off the $39 original price. Other color options are priced significantly higher, and the black version is completely sold out — the light blue version at this price could be snapped up at any moment.

Yes, this is just a simple Bumper case that wraps around the edges and back of your phone, but after all, this is an Apple-made case, and it's currently selling at a clearance price. It lets your phone's design shine through, which is pretty decent for users who just need a little protection — of course, it won't protect the screen or camera module, only the edges.

Amazon's top-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models now $220 off starting today (matching Prime Day pricing)

While the official Apple certified refurbished store is my first choice for iPhone deals, Apple isn't selling its latest iPhone 17 Pro models there yet, and it looks like we'll have to wait until after the 18 series launches next month. Amazon's top-quality Premium Renewed inventory has now returned to Prime Day pricing, saving you up to $220 off the new price.

Amazon's top-tier Premium Renewed inventory has always been the best value for unlocked iPhone 17 Pro models. Besides saving several hundred dollars, you also get a one-year Amazon Renewed warranty, with battery life 'greater than 90% of factory level' — whereas other non-'premium' refurbished models on Amazon only come with a 90-day warranty and don't have such good battery life.

Both 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models are back in stock now, with discounts of up to $220 — the 512GB version is even $20 cheaper than when we last mentioned it:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,215 (new original price $1,499) — historical low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,215 (new original price $1,499) — historical low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,208 (new original price $1,499) — historical low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,166 (new original price $1,299) — historical low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,171 (new original price $1,299) — historical low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,170 (new original price $1,299) — historical low

Anker Prime Power Bank with wall plug function: my favorite portable charger down to $70

Anker and other brands do have plenty of more powerful (or higher-capacity) portable chargers, but this Anker Prime 9,600mAh model is my personal favorite. Now down to $70, it not only has a built-in display but also built-in wall plug prongs, meaning it can double as a wall charger at the same time.

Anker's official Amazon store is now offering the 9,600mAh Prime Power Bank down to $69.99 with free shipping.

This product was originally priced at $90; today's deal matches the ones we've mentioned before as well as the official Prime Day deal from June, making it the lowest price we've tracked on Amazon this year.

To reiterate, there are indeed higher-capacity portable chargers on the market, but this one has always been the most practical choice in my kit. It's more compact than higher-capacity models, and the battery is enough to keep my phone and MacBook running for a full day, plus it has a feature that few other brands offer: built-in wall plug prongs.

In other words, with the foldable wall plug prongs on the back, you can charge the internal battery without needing to bring a separate wall charger — just plug it directly into a wall outlet. When plugged into the wall, it simultaneously charges your device and the internal battery.

In addition, it comes equipped with a pair of USB-C ports and Anker's built-in 1.3-inch smart display:

The product also includes a 2-year warranty, a USB-C cable (100W, braided) and a travel pouch.

Anker's brand-new SmartTrack Find My wallet card (supports iOS or Android) down to $25, Amazon historical low

Anker recently launched a brand-new SmartTrack Find My Card for your wallet — the first product to support both Apple's tracking platform and Google Find Hub — and it's now down to an Amazon historical low of $25, with free shipping for Prime members.

Anker's official EufyHome Amazon store is now offering the brand-new SmartTrack Card E40 (supports iOS or Android) for $24.99, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

This product debuted on Amazon last month priced at $35, then saw a slight $5 discount the following month, and has now hit its first significant price drop, setting a new Amazon historical low.

This price is almost 30% off the original, and it's one of the best wallet tracker card deals we've tracked this year.

I'm personally a big fan of the Nomad Tracking Card — the basic version starts at $35, while the Pro version with 16 months of battery life costs $45 before requiring a recharge — but regardless of which one you choose, I think everyone should put one in their wallet or card holder. I never go out without mine.

Anker's latest SmartTrack Card E40 has all the most important features, including wireless charging, while being compatible with Apple's Find My platform or Google Find Hub. It's only 1.7mm thick, with a maximum ring volume of up to 80 decibels, making it easy to find when it's nearby — and of course, it can be added directly to the Find My and Find Hub apps, so you can see its location on the map.
